data.name: Go West Together
data.detailed_description:
A Wild West Brawl Where Money Is Faster Than Bullets

《Go WEST TOGETHER》 is a multiplayer Wild West brawler for up to 8 players, all fighting over cash and loot. Crack bank vaults, package contraband, search graves, and grab scattered items to make more money than your rivals.

Just remember: the moment you pick up a money bag, you are no longer rich. You are a moving target.

Three Ways to Raise Hell

  • Bounty Hunt — Complete jobs and world events, fight other outlaws, and finish the match with the most cash.
  • Vault Rush — Two teams compete over bank and smuggling jobs. Fill your team wagon while sabotaging the other team's deliveries.
  • Sheriff & Outlaws — An asymmetrical chase. The outlaws work together to fill a shared vault while the sheriff hunts them down and ruins the plan.

An Outlaw's Day Is a Busy One

  • Open bank vaults and carry money bags to a wagon.
  • Package contraband and deliver it before anyone catches you.
  • Search graveyards for a suspiciously decent payday.
  • Hold on to special world-event loot for a major reward.
  • Reason with anyone after your money—or send them flying.

Negotiate With a Wide Selection of Items

Fill your four-slot inventory with whatever you find. Let a pistol do the short talking, give rivals time to reflect with a rope, and tidy up the negotiating table with dynamite, mines, or a smoke bomb. If talks break down, grab a beer or ride away on a toy horse faster than your dignity can follow.

The right item can turn the tables. The wrong one can turn you over.

Greed Has a Price

The biggest jobs take time, and an outlaw at work is an easy target. Run with the bag, steal someone else's haul, or risk everything on a dangerous world event—the choice is yours.

You do not need honor. You only need money.

In the West, the fastest greed survives.
